verdict.rationale: Groq documents a dedicated Batch API for submitting asynchronous batch requests at a 50% discount versus on-demand pricing, with 24hr-7day processing windows and no impact to standard rate limits. This directly matches the story's requirements of async submission and documented discount pricing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of batch job usage or throughput, and more detail on batch job lifecycle/status API beyond the docs summary.
